_comment: REFERENCE / RESEARCH HOSTS for generate-cti-iocs.py — the services an analyst CITES (government and company registries, RDAP/WHOIS services, threat-intel and search platforms, scam-check and review sites, web archives), never the target's own infrastructure. A finding's `source_url` is provenance and is never scanned for indicators at all; this list stops the same hosts being harvested from finding/subject PROSE ('no listing on checkscam-style sites', 'per the RDAP record at …'). Matched exact-or-parent on the URL/domain host (`gov.vn` covers `dkkd.gov.vn`). Only the free-text scan is filtered: an explicit `indicators[]` row (analyst-tagged) is always exported, so a genuinely compromised registry subdomain can still be listed on purpose. Generic public services only — never case data (RULE 1).

apexes._comment: Registrable domains / public suffixes matched exact-or-parent.

host_first_labels._comment: A host whose FIRST label is one of these is a registry lookup service whatever its parent (rdap.<registry>, whois.<registrar>).
